headline: Calibrating nanopore direct RNA sequencing to improve modification site calling
label: Nanopore Rna Modification Profiling
summary: ModkitOpt reports that optimising modkit parameters and stoichiometry cutoffs improves precision of direct RNA modification site calling.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational calibration of direct nanopore RNA sequencing for modification detection. ModkitOpt treats modkit parameters and stoichiometry cutoffs as optimisable inputs to nanopore direct RNA modification site calling, reporting improved precision. The novelty lies in targeting the detection step itself rather than accepting platform output as sufficient. Clair3-RNA, a deep learning small variant caller for long-read RNA-seq, shares the long-read RNA context but addresses variant rather than modification calling, adding coverage normalization, editing site discovery and phasing. Songbird, ITRAP2 and PRISM-seq address copy number calling, antigen assignment and lentiviral integration mapping, respectively, and do not share this calibration focus.
